_: Studies knowingly outstanding against the artefact-currency gate [R-ENF-06]. Seeded 03-Sep-2026, the day the rule was adopted: no study on disk declared the central its secondary artefacts were built against, because the field did not exist until this rule. Cleared by adding the declaration to whatever generates the artefact — and where an artefact has no generator at all, by writing one, which is the deeper defect this gate exposes. It may only ever get SHORTER (--prune).
why_now: Three studies were re-struck on fresh prices and three independent outside audits returned the same verdict for the same reason: the re-strike reached the valuation and not the paper. AMOC's case_adversarial.json carried a base central of 5.954 against a published 11.834 and was READ by three builders and WRITTEN BY NOTHING — it told a reader on page one that surrendering every contested judgement reached EGP 7.47, below the published central, which is impossible. ARCC's efg_bridge.json carried a weighted central of 54.65 and a falling margin path against Appendix A's rising one. EGCH's diagnostics.json and contested_judgements.json were a full edition behind. Not one was visible to any gate, because every gate reads study_numbers.json and none of these files is in it.
note_on_the_seed: AMOC comes off this list at adoption because both its artefacts now declare their vintage — case_adversarial.json through the generator this rule's adoption required somebody to write, since it had none at all, and contested_judgements.json through the shared reverse-read construction. ARCC and EGCH are half done for the same reason and stay listed until their remaining artefacts declare. PHDC carries five undeclared artefacts and is the largest single piece of work here; DU, MODON and TMGH one each. Every one is cleared by adding two lines to whatever generates the file — and where nothing generates it, by writing a generator, which is the deeper defect this gate exposes and the one that produced the impossible sentence on page one of AMOC.
